clauseAfter:
INDEMNIFICATION
Vendor shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Customer and its Affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, losses, liabilities, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Services, Deliverables, or Vendor Technology infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (b) Vendor's breach of Applicable Law; (c) any unauthorized access to, acquisition of, or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor or its personnel, Affiliates, or subcontractors; or (d) Vendor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct.
Vendor's obligation under Section 20.1(a) does not apply to the extent a claim arises from Customer's modification of an item other than as authorized by Vendor, Customer's combination of an item with materials not supplied or recommended by Vendor where the claim would not have arisen but for the combination, or Vendor's compliance with written specifications supplied by Customer.
The indemnified Party shall give the indemnifying Party prompt written notice of a claim, provided that delay excuses the indemnifying Party only to the extent it is materially prejudiced. The indemnifying Party shall control the defence with counsel reasonably acceptable to the indemnified Party, and the indemnified Party shall reasonably cooperate at the indemnifying Party's expense and may participate with its own counsel at its own expense. No settlement imposing a non-monetary obligation, admission of liability, or unreimbursed payment on the indemnified Party is effective without its prior written consent.
Customer shall defend and indemnify Vendor against any third-party claim to the extent arising out of an allegation that content or materials Customer provides to Vendor infringe a third party's intellectual property right, or arising out of Customer's breach of Applicable Law. Customer has no other indemnification obligation under this Agreement.
If an item is or may become the subject of a claim under Section 20.1(a), Vendor shall, at its expense, procure the right for Customer to continue using the item or modify or replace it with a functionally equivalent, non-infringing item. If neither remedy is reasonably achievable, Customer may terminate the affected Services or Deliverable and Vendor shall refund the Fees paid for it, prorated for subscription Services, together with prepaid unused Fees.
comment: [Playbook] The Agreement contains no indemnification section at all, even though Sections 6.3, 10.3, 19.4, 19.5, 21.3 and 30.5 assume indemnities exist and Section 9.3 cross-references remedies "required by Section 20.5" that were never drafted. We have inserted a standard Section 20 giving us Vendor defence and indemnity for third-party IP infringement, breach of law, Vendor-caused Customer Data incidents and gross negligence or wilful misconduct, with customary exclusions, mutual claim procedure, IP remedies that repair the broken 9.3 reference, and our own indemnity kept narrow to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
